functions.recoveredRole: Remove the selected Current Items entry from the Add Watch result
functions.behavior: Reads lbCurrent.ItemIndex. For a nonnegative selection, it deletes the same index first from the private current-items string list and then from lbCurrent.Items. The visible deletion clears the selection. A negative selection is a no-op; lbAll and the all-items collection are unchanged.
functions.evidence: The DFM binds AddWatch.sbRemove.OnClick to address 00f85eb0 and gives the button the hint Delete. FUN_00f85eb0 reads the selected-index property from form field +0x6b0, guards on index >= 0, and invokes the delete slot on +0x710 and on the Items object of +0x6b0 with that same index. FormShow assigns +0x710 to the Items of +0x6b0, while the paired Add handler identifies +0x6b0 as Current Items and +0x6d0 as All Items. The recovered VCL delete method sends LB_DELETESTRING.
